{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Image}}
A '''mineral''' was a natural compound with intricate structure formed through [[Geology|geological]] processes. Examples of minerals included [[Halite/Legends|halite]], [[Quartz/Legends|quartz]], [[Mica (mineral)|mica]], and those used as [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]].

[[Ore/Legends|Ores]] were generally comprised of minerals of economic importance or industrial value.

[[Permex]] was a substance that utilized an injection of mineral solution into polymeric plastic.<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>

[[Azurite]] was a highly prized mineral commonly found in mines. [[Ionite]] was another highly prized mineral found in mines but not so commonly found and more valuable.
